description: November 2 birthday meaning: Scorpio decan 1, birthday number 2, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a November 2 birthday falls in Scorpio, in the first decan, with Pluto as the sign's ruler and Pluto as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 2. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Scorpio is fixed and water.

sections.heading: Personality of a November 2 birthday
paragraphs: Close bonds sit at the heart of November 2. Nine degrees of Scorpio is the final degree of Pluto's decan, giving emotional depth and loyalty, and the birthday number 2 brings receptivity and a gift for partnership. Together they describe someone whose relationships are few but profound, and who tends to read a partner's mood before a word is spoken.

By noon UTC on November 2, the Sun has normally reached roughly 9° of Scorpio. That places the date in the Scorpio decan that astrologers give to Pluto, the first of three. Pluto rules Scorpio in modern astrology and also governs its first decan, so late October and the first days of November hold the sign in concentrated form. This decan is traditionally associated with intensity, privacy and a capacity to go deep into whatever it touches, whether a relationship, a mystery or a personal reinvention. Trust tends to be slow and, once given, complete. Doubled Pluto can bring a strong will and a reluctance to show vulnerability. Natives often find their power in honest transformation: releasing what no longer fits rather than guarding it out of habit.

sections.heading: Numerology of the November 2 birthday
paragraphs: A birthday on the 2nd gives a birthday number of 2, unreduced and simple. Numerologists treat the day of birth as a secondary influence, a natural skill that colours the main Life Path without overriding it. The 2 is the number of the pair, so it is traditionally linked with tact, sensitivity and an instinct for what other people need. Someone born on this day may be the quiet mediator in a group, noticing tension long before it surfaces. The challenge often described for 2s is voicing their own view rather than adjusting it to keep the peace.

Because the year enters the Life Path calculation, the same November 2 birthday leads to different paths across generations, among them 22 for 1980, 5 for 1990, 6 for 2000 and 7 for 2010. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 22. The Life Path calculator does the reduction for any year.

sections.heading: November 2 in context: the season, Chinese zodiac and famous birthdays
paragraphs: A November birthday falls in late autumn for the northern hemisphere, a season of bare branches and early dusk, and in late spring for the southern, when the days lengthen fast. Scorpio holds most of the month, with Sagittarius arriving around November 22. In numerology November is month 11, a master number that is traditionally kept unreduced and linked with intuition and inspiration. November 2 is the 306th day of the year (307th in a leap year). In most years Sagittarius season is under way by November 23, 21 days after this birthday.

Chinese astrology is straightforward for a November 2 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies. November 2 is also the birthday of James K. Polk (1795), Warren G. Harding (1865) and Shah Rukh Khan (1965).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is November 2?
faq.answer: November 2 is Scorpio in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the first decan of Scorpio, which tradition links with Pluto.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on November 2?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On November 2 the Life Path is 2 in 1960, 3 in 1970, 22 in 1980, 5 in 1990, 6 in 2000, 7 in 2010 and 8 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 2 for everyone born on the 2nd.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on November 2?
faq.answer: By November 2 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on November 2?
faq.answer: Among the best-known people with a November 2 birthday are James K. Polk (1795), Warren G. Harding (1865) and Shah Rukh Khan (1965). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
